summary: A minimal starter firmware for developers: it only plays a 4-voice sine on the keys, but includes the platform a real FM-1 firmware needs so you can build your own on top.
features: Working update path, USB rescue mode and crash screen
USB and TRS MIDI in one queue, with clock; class-compliant USB audio
Flash storage for settings, blobs and slots, each CRC-checked
Host mode renders sound to WAV and screen to images
Build refuses code that could brick the unit; also targets the SMK-37
Not an instrument: the app itself is a simple sine synth

headings: 7. make it yours, release it, get into the hub
